description: Set or clear organization webhook URLs via PUT /v1/organization/{id}/webhooks. Requires a full API Access key. Empty string clears a URL; omitted fields are left unchanged. URLs must be https. organization_id is optional and derived from the API key when omitted. See the webhooks guide. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_set_webhooks
